notes.title: Update & Bug Fixes - 0523
notes.content:
Update

1. The skill point requirement for all units has been reduced.

2. Antbat's poison skill has been newly reworked.

3. The HP bar UI has been redesigned.


Bug Fixes

1. Fixed an issue where the tutorial did not complete properly even after finishing.

2. Fixed missing translations in certain languages.

3. Fixed an issue where some character skills were not triggering correctly.

notes.title: Update & Bug Fixes 0428
notes.content:
Update

The "Fusion Chamber" has been added.
The Fusion Chamber becomes available starting from Stage 3, and can also be used in Stages 1 and 2 after completing the tutorial.
The Fusion Chamber allows you to combine two identical units to enhance their stats.
(Units that require plasma energy or have already been fused cannot be used.)

Stat increases from fusion are as follows:

- Attack and Energy Attack: +50%
- Defense and Energy Defense: +1
- Health: +50%
- Health Regeneration: +1
- Attack Speed and Accuracy: +20%

Create various powerful combinations using the Fusion Chamber!

Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where the tutorial would continue to repeat even after completion.
- Fixed an issue where some character stats were displayed incorrectly.

notes.title: Bug Fixes 0421
notes.content:

Thank you.

notes.title: Emergency Bug Fixes 0327
notes.content:
Hello,

We’ve discovered and fixed several bugs in the Prologue version. A new build has been uploaded.

Please note: After the patch, previously selected skills will be reset.

Patch Notes:

1.Fixed a bug where the Oat's healing unit could not be summoned

2.Fixed an issue where the background music would suddenly mute when lowering the volume

3.Fixed a bug where increasing one stat would incorrectly raise another stat

Thank you!

notes.title: Prologue Version Now Available
notes.content:
Hello!

You can now play the Prologue version of the game.

(Progress from the demo version does not carry over.)

This version is an update of the previous demo and includes the following new features:

🔄 Updates

1. Gameplay
[list]
[*] Added 6 Rare items and 6 Legendary items
[*] Increased drop rate for Rare items (15% → 20%)
[*] Unlock a new unit after clearing Stage 3
[*] Max level cap raised to 10
[/list]


2. UI & Interface
[list]
[*] Display of perks & mutations used upon mission clear
[*] Task window layout changed (Before: 4 x 3 → After: 3 x 3)
[*] Tutorial messages can now be clicked with the Tab key
[/list]

I always welcome your feedback!
Feel free to share your thoughts via Discord or the Steam Community.
